state.shadowed.en: Id taken by a preset another plugin declares
state.shadowed.zh: id 已被其它插件声明的预设占用

code.detail.zh: {files} 个代码文件 · {expressions} 个 !!js 表达式 · {plugins} 个插件

confirm.text.en: Installing "{name}" loads its composition inside the DSH host process, which carries the same trust as shell access. {detail} Continue?
confirm.text.zh: 「{name}」安装后会在 DSH 主进程内加载其组合内容，权限等同 shell 访问。{detail} 确认继续？

uninstall.text.en: Unregisters "{name}" and deletes its local files (the copy under $DSH_HOME/agent-presets). Sessions already using it keep running.
uninstall.text.zh: 将注销「{name}」并删除其本地文件（$DSH_HOME/agent-presets 中的副本）。已使用该预设的会话不受影响。

note.conflict.en: A directory with this id already exists locally; nothing was overwritten
note.conflict.zh: 本地已存在同名目录，未覆盖任何文件

note.enabled.en: Installed and enabled; refresh the page to see it under Settings - Agent presets
note.enabled.zh: 已安装并启用；刷新页面后在「设置 → Agent 预设」中可见

note.disabled.en: Disabled; the files stay in the preset library and can be enabled again
note.disabled.zh: 已停用；文件仍保留在预设库中，可随时重新启用

note.shadowed.en: A preset another plugin declares already owns this id, so it cannot be declared
note.shadowed.zh: 该 id 已被另一插件声明的预设占用，无法声明

note.defaultPreset.en: This is the current default preset; change the default under Settings - Agent presets first
note.defaultPreset.zh: 这是当前默认预设，请先在「设置 → Agent 预设」切换默认值

note.rosterUnavailable.en: The host exposes no agent-preset registry service, so presets cannot be declared
note.rosterUnavailable.zh: 宿主未提供 agent-preset 注册表服务，无法声明预设

note.gatewayUnavailable.en: Local gateway unavailable: remote browser or host routes not mounted; install and enable are disabled
note.gatewayUnavailable.zh: 本机网关不可用：远程浏览器或 host 路由未挂载，无法安装或启用

note.emptyCatalog.en: The community preset catalog is empty

note.remoteInstall.en: Run this in a browser on the machine hosting DSH
note.remoteInstall.zh: 请在运行 DSH 的本机浏览器中操作
